# Fish Shell

> Fish (friendly interactive shell) is a smart and user-friendly command line shell for Linux, macOS, and the rest of the family.

## Getting Started
- [Home](https://fishshell.com/)
- [Tutorial](https://fishshell.com/docs/current/tutorial.html)
- [FAQ](https://fishshell.com/docs/current/faq.html)
- [Fish for Bash Users](https://fishshell.com/docs/current/fish_for_bash_users.html)
